import sys

def main():
    dna = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    whole_counter = 0
    temp_counter = 1
    previous_character = dna[0]
    i = 1

    while i < len(dna):
        current_character = dna[i]
        if current_character == previous_character:
            temp_counter += 1
            if i == len(dna) - 1:
                if temp_counter % 2 == 0:
                    whole_counter += 1
                    temp_counter = 1
            else:
                next_character = dna[i + 1]
                if next_character != previous_character and temp_counter % 2 == 0:
                    whole_counter += 1
                    temp_counter = 1
        else:
            previous_character = current_character
        i += 1

    print(whole_counter)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
